entities.summary: The University of Arezzo was an Italian university founded in 1215 that is located in the town of Arezzo in the Tuscan region of Italy. It was recognized as a studium generale from early in the 13th century but declined in importance after being overtaken by newer Italian universities and closed in 1520. The University of Siena has operated a branch campus in Arezzo since 1969.
